pr_title: Log malformed URLs instead of ignoring them silently
pr_body:
##### Summary
Closes #8774 
Add a log message when the agent does not understand the cloud URL in a request.

##### Component Name
aclk

##### Test Plan
Run the agent without json-c installed (before we patch to make it a hard dep) and check the error is shown when the agent is connected to the cloud.

##### Additional Information
Problem will be hidden once json-c is a hard dep, must be tested before then.

issue_context.title: There is no log of a failure to understand requests from the cloud
issue_context.body: If the URL in the payload for a cloud request is not understood then no error is log (the agent fails to process it silently). To see this connect an agent without json-c installed to the cloud, no charts are produced and no error is logged.
comments: Error is already propagated to the other side.

review_comments: The `else` is the success case so this will not work.
I'm confused, why does it copy the payload into the structure if it is the failure case?
It copies the original string so that the final error will be generated by the webapi.
So is there an error being sent back over the link in the response?

There will the `code` set and the body will have the error message. It will send the same error code and text description that we get from typing the malformed url in `/api/v1/data?.....` 


Example

If the cloud requests a chart `system.lio` instead of `system.io` the following will be generated

(note this includes the TTL PR)


"\t{\"type\": \"http\",\n\t\"msg-id\": \"1fbde3c8-f9e4-4a0d-ad49-f0ae89e50884\",\n\t\"timestamp\": 1587396428,\n\t\"timestamp-offset-usec\": 346294,\n\t\"connect\": 1587396241,\n\t\"connect-offset-usec\": 135655,\n\t\"version\": 1,\n\t\"payload\": {\n\"code\": 404,\n\"body\": \"Chart is not found: system.lio\",\n\"headers\": \"HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found\\u000d\\nConnection: close\\u000d\\nServer: NetData Embedded HTTP Server v1.21.1-40-g37a963f3\\u000d\\nAccess-Control-Allow-Origin: *\\u000d\\nAccess-Control-Allow-Credentials: true\\u000d\\nContent-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8\\u000d\\nDate: Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT\\u000d\\nCache-Control: no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate\\u000d\\nPragma: no-cache\\u000d\\nExpires: Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:01 GMT\\u000d\\nContent-Length: 30\\u000d\\n\\u000d\\n\"\n}\n}"
